description: Turn a natural-language app idea ("an app that...") into a working, double-clickable Windows .exe — with ZERO git, GitHub, terminal, or build knowledge required from the user. Covers stack choice (default: Python + Tkinter + PyInstaller; alternatives: pywebview/Tauri, .NET WinForms), Python bootstrap via winget/py launcher, minimal project scaffold, implementation rules, onedir vs onefile, install folder + Desktop shortcut, smoke test, startup measurement, antivirus false-positive caveats, and delivery. Use when the user asks to "make an app from my prompt", "create an exe", "build a Windows app", "build an app from a prompt", "assemble the exe", or reports that a generated app "didn't work" / "won't open on Windows".
